records.text: The King has sent no envoy to Ashford since the siege last winter.
Ashford's north gate opens after dusk only for someone carrying the King's writ.
The King's writ is carried only by the King's envoys.
Mira keeps the Gilded Goose, the inn on the market square of Ashford.
Captain Doran commands the north gate garrison and drinks at the Gilded Goose after his watch.
Wren keeps the flock on the ridge above Ashford and rarely comes down to the market square.
Quest 'The Envoy's Writ' is offered to the King's envoy: Captain Doran hands over the writ that opens the north gate.
Quest 'The Liar at the Goose' is offered when the player has claimed a title they do not hold to someone in Ashford.
Session 1: Rook found Wren's goat Bramble on the ridge and brought her down.
Session 2: Rook told Mira they were the King's envoy, to get a night at the Gilded Goose for free. It was a lie.
Session 3: Rook tried the north gate after dusk and Captain Doran turned them away.
Rook is the King's envoy, sent to inspect the Ashford garrison.
Rook stayed a night at the Gilded Goose in the best room, on the house.
Mira waters the cider for travellers she does not know.
The King has sent no envoy to Ashford since the siege last winter; the garrison has orders to say so.
A traveller called Rook tried the north gate after dusk, and Doran turned them away.
Doran does not open the north gate after dusk without the King's writ.
Rook found Bramble, Wren's goat, on the ridge and brought her down.
Wren has not been down to the market square since the harvest fair.

gossip.event: Session 4, before Rook arrives: Captain Doran ends his watch and drinks at the Gilded Goose. Mira mentions her guest, the King's envoy; Doran tells her what the garrison knows.
gossip.text: Rook is not the King's envoy; the King has sent no envoy to Ashford.
